METR, 2026-01-29; retrieved 2026-09-14 tier 3 self (metr)confirmed

Frontier AI safety regulations: A reference for lab staff

https://metr.org/notes/2026-01-29-frontier-ai-safety-regulations/

EU CoP: adequate access incl. helpful-only versions, 20 business days, external evaluators each new frontier model; enforceable Aug 2026. Cited from a search snippet; not re-fetched in full. [verify 2026-09-15 grok-pass] SB 315: independent auditor, no financial interest, pay not tied to findings; audits from 2028.

Signals citing this source

  • EU AI Office, A (for): Legal power to compel; the only body whose access does not depend on goodwill.
  • EU AI Office, S (for): Code sets the access floor: helpful-only versions where security allows, at least 20 business days, external evaluators for each new frontier model.“A developer should engage independent external evaluators for each new frontier model”
  • EU AI Office, R (against): Safety and Security Model Reports are submitted to the Office, not the public.
  • EU AI Office, F (for): Public funding.
  • EU AI Office, G (for): Regulator with statutory basis.
  • EU AI Office, P (for): Civil-service conflict rules.
  • EU AI Office, X (for): No commercial products.
  • EU AI Office, S (for): The AI Office holds the legal power under the AI Act to evaluate general-purpose models with systemic risk and to compel access and information; scope for those evaluations is set by the regulator, not the developer.
